data.one_liner: GBK codec converter library for encoding and decoding strings and byte streams.
data.what_it_does: Provides a pure Dart solution for encoding and decoding GBK character sets. Includes standard 16-bits codec and a byte codec for handling byte streams.
use_when: You need to encode or decode GBK encoded text in a pure Dart application
You are parsing web pages or streams using the GBK character encoding
avoid_when: You only work with standard UTF-8 encodings supported natively by Dart
strengths: Pure Dart solution supporting all platforms
Provides both standard 16-bit codec and byte stream codec
